summary: 0 A.D. is a cross-platform real-time strategy game focused on ancient warfare. It provides an environment for managing resources, constructing bases, and training military units.
goodFor: It is suitable for users looking for open-source strategy games to install on their local machines.
watchOut: As a desktop strategy game rather than a server-based application, it typically requires direct hardware rendering and local client installation rather than a standard headless server deployment.
deployNotes: Deployment relies on standard packaging formats such as deb files, meaning you will need to handle local system dependencies and package management on compatible operating systems.
